Commit your way to the LORD, [Name]. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
He will cover you with his feathers, [Name]. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.
He will not allow your foot to be moved, [Name]. He who keeps you will not slumber.
Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips, [Name].
Commit your deeds to the LORD, [Name], and your plans shall succeed.
Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end, [Name].
If you stop listening to instruction, my son, [Name], you will stray from the words of knowledge.
Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty, [Name]. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.
Prepare your work outside, [Name], and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.
so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man, [Name].
Debate your case with your neighbor, [Name], and don’t betray the confidence of another,
Have you found honey, [Name]? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.
Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, [Name], lest he be weary of you, and hate you.
for you will heap coals of fire on his head, [Name], and the LORD will reward you.
Do you see a man wise in his own eyes, [Name]? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
Do you see a man who is hasty in his words, [Name]? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

my son, [Name], don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
Then you will understand righteousness and justice, [Name], equity and every good path.
For wisdom will enter into your heart, [Name]. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Discretion will watch over you, [Name]. Understanding will keep you,
to deliver you from the way of evil, [Name], from the men who speak perverse things,
My son, [Name], don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,
for they will add to you length of days, [Name], years of life, and peace.
Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you, [Name]. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.
So you will find favor, [Name], and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
Trust in the LORD with all your heart, [Name], and don’t lean on your own understanding.
In all your ways acknowledge him, [Name], and he will make your paths straight.
Don’t be wise in your own eyes, [Name]. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
It will be health to your body, [Name], and nourishment to your bones.
Honor the LORD with your substance, [Name], with the first fruits of all your increase;
so your barns will be filled with plenty, [Name], and your vats will overflow with new wine.
My son, [Name], don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;
She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her, [Name].
My son, [Name], let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,
so they will be life to your soul, [Name], and grace for your neck.
Then you shall walk in your way securely, [Name]. Your foot won’t stumble.
When you lie down, [Name], you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.
for the LORD will be your confidence, [Name], and will keep your foot from being taken.
Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it, [Name].
Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm, [Name].
Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you, [Name]. Love her, and she will keep you.
Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, [Name], get understanding.
Esteem her, and she will exalt you, [Name]. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.
She will give to your head a garland of grace, [Name]. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”
Listen, my son, [Name], and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.
I have taught you in the way of wisdom, [Name]. I have led you in straight paths.
When you go, [Name], your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.
Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life, [Name].
My son, [Name], attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.
Let them not depart from your eyes, [Name]. Keep them in the center of your heart.
Keep your heart with all diligence, [Name], for out of it is the wellspring of life.
Put away from yourself a perverse mouth, [Name]. Put corrupt lips far from you.
Let your eyes look straight ahead, [Name]. Fix your gaze directly before you.
Make the path of your feet level, [Name]. Let all of your ways be established.
My son, [Name], pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,
My son, [Name], if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,
you are trapped by the words of your mouth, [Name]; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.
Do this now, my son, [Name], and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.
Give no sleep to your eyes, [Name], nor slumber to your eyelids.
Free yourself, [Name], like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.
so your poverty will come as a robber, [Name], and your scarcity as an armed man.
My son, [Name], keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you, [Name]. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
For by me your days will be multiplied, [Name]. The years of your life will be increased.
If you are wise, [Name], you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.
Turn your ear, [Name], and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, [Name], if all of them are ready on your lips.
Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge, [Name],
To teach you truth, [Name], reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, [Name], of those who are collateral for debts.
If you don’t have means to pay, [Name], why should he take away your bed from under you?
Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up, [Name].
Do you see a man skilled in his work, [Name]? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
When you sit to eat with a ruler, [Name], consider diligently what is before you;
put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite, [Name].
Don’t weary yourself to be rich, [Name]. In your wisdom, show restraint.
Why do you set your eyes on that which is not, [Name]? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words, [Name].
Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words, [Name].
for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you, [Name].
Apply your heart to instruction, [Name], and your ears to the words of knowledge.
My son, [Name], if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right, [Name].
Listen, my son, [Name], and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!
Let your father and your mother be glad, [Name]! Let her who bore you rejoice!
Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, [Name], or as he who lies on top of the rigging:
for by wise guidance you wage your war, [Name], and victory is in many advisors.
If you falter in the time of trouble, [Name], your strength is small.
My son, [Name], eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;
so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul, [Name]. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.
Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls, [Name]. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,
My son, [Name], fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,
Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring, [Name].
Let another man praise you, [Name], and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.
Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend, [Name]. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.
Be wise, my son, [Name], and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.
Know well the state of your flocks, [Name], and pay attention to your herds,
The lambs are for your clothing, [Name], and the goats are the price of a field.
There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, [Name], for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
{name}, the LORD who created and redeemed His people calls His own by name. In Christ you belong to Him — so take courage in His redeeming love and do not fear.
{name}, the same God who promised Israel His presence, strength and help is your God in Christ. You need not fear or be dismayed, for He upholds His own.
